annotation.bound_parties_text: The Order modifies regulation 109(1) of the Construction and Use Regulations for drivers of automated vehicles, permitting them to view information on built-in apparatus when the vehicle is driving itself.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: regulation 109 allows drivers of automated vehicles to be in such a position as to be able to see, whether directly or by reflection, information of any sort
annotation.dates_quote: This Order may be cited as the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) (Automated Vehicles) Order 2022 and comes into force on 1st July 2022.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: This Order applies to automated vehicles as defined by section 1(4) of the Automated and Electric Vehicles Act 2018
